_comment: Hot-reload: changes apply without a restart (see core/runtime_config.py). 'voice' is '<model>' or '<model>#<speaker>' (e.g. 'de_DE-mls-medium#42'), or a list of those - a pool; 'voice_pick' then decides: 'random' = a fresh pick per message, 'per_user' = the same voice for the same viewer every time - which models are installed is decided by voices.txt (Dockerfile), not here - easiest to set on the admin page, http://127.0.0.1:4457/tts/admin?token=<TTS_TOKEN> (docs/tts.md). Every sentence the bot says or speaks lives under 'texts'; {placeholders} in curly braces get filled in and must stay.

speech._comment: How it is spoken. Leave a key out (or null) for the model's own default. length_scale >1 = slower; noise_scale = variation in intonation; noise_w_scale = variation in sound lengths; sentence_silence = pause after a sentence in seconds. Try values live on the admin page (/tts/admin).

replacements._comment: Whole words, case-insensitive, replaced before speaking - for chat shorthand. An empty string drops the word (laughing emotes read out sound silly). English results are then pronounced in English if they are in english_words.

english_words: _comment: words and phrases pronounced in English (with the voice's own accent) instead of read the German way - nice is otherwise niike, Game Gahme. Whole words, case-insensitive. Add what your chat writes.

command_names._comment: Rename commands, give them aliases, or switch them off: "!tts": "!vorlesen" | "!tts": ["!vorlesen", "!sag"] | "!tts": false

texts.help.tts: Cheer ab {need} Bits mit Nachricht wird vorgelesen. Ohne Nachricht geht es aufs Guthaben - einlösbar mit !tts <text> oder !companion <text>.
texts.needs_bits: Fürs Vorlesen werden {need} Bits benötigt (aktuelles Guthaben: {have}). Ein Cheer ohne Nachricht lädt das Guthaben auf.
texts.queue_full: Die Vorlese-Warteschlange ist gerade voll - versuch es später nochmal.
texts.http.nothing_playing: läuft nichts - noch {remaining} in der Warteschlange
texts.http.error: Fehler beim Erzeugen - nochmal versuchen oder /skip
texts.nothing_to_say: Da bleibt nichts zum Vorlesen übrig (nur Emojis oder Links?) - es wurde nichts abgebucht.
